item.title: Uber Canada urging drivers to protest proposed licencing changes in Halifax region
item.description: HALIFAX — Uber Canada is doubling down on its bid to stop the Halifax region from imposing new licencing requirements on ride-sharing services, saying the proposed rules will drive up fares and entangle drivers in red tape.

item.title: N.S. lobster exports outside China are picking up as tariffs soften demand
item.description: HALIFAX — Nova Scotia’s lobster sector is feeling the pinch from Chinese tariffs this year, but officials say exporters are starting to crack other international markets.

item.title: 'You cannot break us': Protesters rally in Minneapolis after ICE fatal shooting
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS — Thousands gathered in Minneapolis on Saturday to push back on the Trump administration's deployment of federal forces after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer shot and killed a woman earlier this week.

item.title: Atmospheric river expected along B.C. south coast; 'main brunt' arriving Sunday
item.description: VANCOUVER — Environment Canada says an atmospheric river will take aim at British Columbia's south coast this weekend as heavy rain continues to batter the north coast.

item.title: Kempe lifts road Kings to 4-3 shootout win over Oilers
item.description: EDMONTON — Adrian Kempe scored the shootout winner as the Los Angeles Kings earned a ration of revenge from last year’s playoffs, defeating the Edmonton Oilers 4-3 on Saturday in the first meeting between the two teams since last spring.
